status: amendment frozen after the held-out-expression informativeness check and before any learned cost-feature representation result
amendment_reason: The original 100-feature held-out-expression endpoint was rejected because the no-training identity baseline had patient-level median top-1 retrieval 1.000. The already generated 500 cost features have a non-ceiling identity baseline (diagnostic median top-1 0.872) and are therefore used for a model-conditioned downstream stress test. No learning result from this amended analysis was inspected before freezing this configuration.

positive_pair_quality.endpoint: known-correspondence precision among retained top-1 pseudo-positive pairs
positive_pair_quality.aggregation: mean directions within patient; patients are independent units

representation_transfer.status: model-conditioned controlled downstream stress test; not an independent witness and not a full AlignDG reproduction
representation_transfer.features: 500 row-normalized cost features already used in OT cost construction
representation_transfer.split: five deterministic spatial blocks within direction
representation_transfer.model: multi-output ridge mapping from source to target cost-feature representation
representation_transfer.primary_endpoint: known-correspondence top1 retrieval on held-out spatial blocks
representation_transfer.aggregation: mean folds within direction; mean directions within patient; patients are independent units

statistics.paired_test: exact two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on non-zero patient-level top2-margin minus max-probability effects; exact zero differences are reported as ties
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction across the three OT methods for the primary endpoint
statistics.effect_summary: patient-level median difference with IQR and deterministic patient bootstrap 95% interval

claim_boundary: This amended representation analysis can test whether the score used to select pseudo-positive pairs changes recovery of the already model-used cost representation. Because the evaluation features also enter OT cost construction, it is model-conditioned and cannot serve as independent external validation, prove full AlignDG improvement, or establish real-section biological utility.
